evidence.title: Honda brings major update on new F1 engine’s first outing
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Honda will put its updated Formula 1 power unit through its paces this week, ahead of its mooted debut after the summer break. [e002:f02] The Japanese giants have been placed firmly under the microscope amid a so far wretched return to F1, as engine manufacturer to Aston Martin. [e002:f03] Its power unit is significantly slower than that of its rivals, leaving the Silverstone-based squad languishing at the back of the field, having been midfield contenders over the last few seasons. [e002:f04] Having naturally qualified for the Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities [ADUO] scheme as per this year's new technical regulations, Honda has been hard at work to produce a significant amount of extra horsepower. [e002:f05] Aston debuted its own upgrades package in Hungary, the B-spec AMR26 showing some clear improvements through aero changes, which it hopes will be successfully accompanied by the new Honda upgrades. [e002:f06] Speaking after the race at the Hungaroring, its trackside chief, Shintaro Orihara, confirmed that a filming day test, also at the same circuit, will be its debut outing ahead of its scheduled first appearance in Zandvoort. [e002:f07] "In Hungary, we have been supporting the team with the power unit integration," he said. [e002:f08] "We’ve also been able to collect vital data, which will help us come the next race. [e002:f09] "We will now take the important step of introducing our new spec power unit in the Netherlands. [e002:f10] Before then, during Wednesday’s filming day, we will run the new engine in the AMR26 for the first time, before the summer shutdown commences." Shintaro Orihara has confirmed its updated power unit will debut this week Honda hoping for 'laptime gain' from joint upgrades with Aston Martin Whilst Aston failed to score points in Hungary, Lance Stroll and Fernando Alonso finished 13th and 14th, a remarkable achievement given the myriad of problems the car has faced since its debut in Melbourne. [e002:f11] Orihara intimated the result was a springboard full of confidence that it will carry into the test, and hopefully, the Dutch Grand Prix, when the two upgrades will jointly run together. [e002:f12] "Now we are back to racing the field," he said. [e002:f13] "Then, all improvement is very important to catch up to others. [e002:f14] To introduce the new power unit in Zandvoort is quite important, now the chassis is working well. [e002:f15] So our power unit should bring some laptime gain." The continuing work rate put in by both Sakira and Silverstone sides of the operation has been remarkable, given its starting point. [e002:f16] And even if Aston fails to score any more points this season, a similar trajectory in performance will be considered a huge result in itself.

evidence.title: 2027 Honda Odyssey Preview: Specs, Price, Release Date
evidence.body: [e003:f01] Preview 2029 2027 New 2026 Used 2025 2024 2023 2022 More Preview 2029 2027 New 2026 Used 2025 2024 2023 2022 2021 2020 2019 2018 2017 2016 2015 2014 2013 2012 2011 2010 2009 2008 2007 2006 2005 2004 2003 2002 2001 2000 1999 1998 1997 1996 1995 GO By Joel Patel Automotive Editor July 27, 2026 What To Expect With reports indicating that the Honda Odyssey will be redesigned in 2029 , we expect the 2027 model to be a carryover vehicle. [e003:f02] Still available with a 3.5-liter V6 engine. [e003:f03] Honda hasn't confirmed official information. [e003:f04] Honda hasn’t confirmed any details about the 2027 model yet, but here’s what we expect to see from the 2027 Honda Odyssey. [e003:f05] As a carryover model, the 2027 Honda Odyssey should continue to have the same exterior design as the current model that’s on sale. [e003:f06] Honda isn’t expected to make any changes to the Odyssey's design for 2027. [e003:f07] The current model has a dated interior design with a sloping dashboard, a large four-pronged steering wheel, and triangular air vents. [e003:f08] The Odyssey’s center console follows the shape of a V, integrating physical controls and push-button controls for the gear shifter. [e003:f09] Because of its design, the Odyssey has an enormous cabin with three rows of seats. [e003:f10] On the tech front, the 2027 Honda Odyssey will come with a seven-inch driver information display, a nine-inch touchscreen, wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, three USB-C ports, an HD Radio, satellite radio, a Wi-Fi hotspot, and seven audio speakers. [e003:f11] Stay Informed We'll email you as soon as the 2027 Honda Odyssey becomes available. [e003:f15] 2027 Honda Odyssey Release Date We don’t know when the 2027 Honda Odyssey will go on sale, but we estimate that the minivan will arrive at dealerships this summer based on last year’s schedule. Honda Launches ZR-V Hybrid at ₹47.99 Lakh to Revive India Sales
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Honda Cars India has launched its flagship ZR-V e:HEV hybrid SUV in the Indian market with a price tag of ₹47.99 lakh. [e001:f02] As the vehicle is brought in as a completely built unit, it attracts high import duties, positioning it as a niche premium offering rather than a high-volume product. [e001:f03] The launch is part of a larger plan by the company to refresh its portfolio, including updates to the Elevate SUV and the eventual introduction of a locally manufactured electric SUV by FY27. [e001:f04] Sales Performance and Market Context This move comes as Honda attempts to stabilize its operations following a period of declining sales and market share. [e001:f05] While the company reported a return to growth in the first quarter of FY27, with retail registrations rising 6.2% to 14,668 units and domestic wholesales increasing 20.9% to 14,423 units, this performance remains behind the broader industry growth rate. [e001:f06] In comparison, the total passenger vehicle market saw retail registrations grow by approximately 21% and wholesales by 25.9% during the same period, indicating that Honda is currently growing slower than the overall sector. [e001:f07] Reliance on Core Models A key concern for investors is the company’s heavy concentration on the Amaze compact sedan, which represented nearly 59% of Honda’s domestic wholesale volumes in the first quarter of FY27. [e001:f08] This reliance stands in contrast to the wider industry shift toward utility vehicles, which accounted for roughly 68% of total passenger vehicle wholesales in the same quarter. [e001:f09] Strategic Objectives The ZR-V is intended to serve as a brand builder, showcasing Honda’s advanced hybrid technology and safety features such as Level 2 ADAS. [e001:f10] By entering the segment at ₹47.99 lakh, the company is competing against established electric models like the Hyundai Ioniq 5 and BYD Seal. [e001:f11] Because the model is imported, its financial contribution to Honda’s local profitability is expected to be limited compared to locally manufactured units. [e001:f12] Investors monitoring Honda should focus on the commissioning timelines for the company's upcoming mass-market projects and the impact of these launches on domestic market share, as the company works to reduce its high dependence on the entry-level sedan segment.

evidence.title: Lagrue hired to lead Red Bull Junior Programme in 2027
F1 Today | Red Bull appoint Marko successor, as Mekies delivers key development update
evidence.body: [e006:f01] Red Bull officially appoints Marko's successor from Mercedes Red Bull have officially confirmed the appointment of Gwen Lagrue as Director of the Red Bull Junior Programme. [e006:f02] Reporting directly to CEO and Team Principal Laurent Mekies, Lagrue joins from Mercedes having been in charge of the Silver Arrows' Junior Driver Programme since 2016. [e006:f03] Lagrue has played a central role in identifying and developing young prospects at Mercedes, helping guide current drivers George Russell and Kimi Antonelli all the way to full-time Formula 1 race seats, and battling at the top of the F1 standings. [e006:f04] At Red Bull, it is anticipated he will fill the shoes of former motorsport advisor Helmut Marko, who led the Milton Keynes team's development of drivers such as Max Verstappen and Sebastian Vettel across two decades. [e006:f05] In a statement, team boss Mekies said: "Gwen is one of the very best talent developers in F1 and I know first-hand the expertise, leadership and passion he brings to developing young drivers. [e006:f06] The Red Bull Junior Programme has always been a cornerstone of Red Bull's success, and having Gwen lead it reflects the importance we continue to place on developing the next generation of F1 talent." The Frenchman also made sure to pay tribute to Marko, who departed Red Bull after 20 years in December 2025. [e006:f07] Mekies said: "We want to recognise another time today the extraordinary contribution Helmut Marko has made over more than two decades creating and leading the Junior Programme. [e006:f08] "The Junior Programme has become the benchmark in F1 because of his vision, commitment and ability to identify and develop exceptional talents and he deserves enormous credit for that." "As we continue to build the next chapter of Oracle Red Bull Racing , attracting leaders of Gwen's calibre is fundamental to achieving our ambitions. [e006:f09] We're strengthening our high-performance organisation with outstanding people in every part of the business, and Gwen is an important addition on that journey. [e006:f10] Together, we will build on an incredibly strong foundation while continuing to evolve the programme for the future." Photo: Race Pictures Photo: Race Pictures Mekies delivers verdict Verstappen won't want to hear on Red Bull upgrades Meanwhile, Mekies has also delivered an update on Red Bull's timeline regarding the decision on whether to prioritise the RB22's development in 2026, or shift focus to 2027. [e006:f11] While Verstappen remains unhappy with the RB22 - even despite an impressive drive to P2 at the weekend's Hungarian GP - the Dutchman might have to accept he's stuck with his current machinery sooner rather than later, with Mekies confirming Red Bull's plan to shift their attention to 2027 development earlier than they had done the season prior. [e006:f12] After a question from GPblog about short-term plans, the Frenchman said: "At some stage we'll need to make a call on the balance between this year and next year. [e006:f13] And I expect that to happen earlier than what we have done last year, especially as the regulations are how they are. [e006:f14] So we will decide." Mekies added that Red Bull have made an enormous development push in recent months, but that it is difficult to foresee the Austrian team continuing "at that rhythm." He continued: "As far as we are concerned, we have brought a huge amount of development to the car between race one and here in order to try to correct as soon as possible the large deficit we had initially. [e006:f15] "And it’s difficult to imagine that we will continue at that rhythm, but we nonetheless need to see what is the best way to try and close these last three tenths," he concluded, without indication on when Red Bull would bring the next update package.

evidence.title: Why Aston Martin's B-Spec Upgrades Signal a Midfield F1 Revival
evidence.body: [e002:f01] SF Streamline Feed Official Verified Jul 27, 2026 Updated Jul 27, 2026 4 min read Follow on Google News Build your reading streak 0 / 3 today · Counts at 25% The Hungaroring circuit in Budapest is notoriously unforgiving, demanding maximum downforce and exposing the slightest aerodynamic flaw. [e002:f02] Yet, during the Hungarian Grand Prix weekend, it provided the perfect crucible for Aston Martin's heavily anticipated AMR26 B-spec car. [e002:f03] While drivers Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll finished just outside the points on Sunday, securing 13th and 14th place respectively, the underlying telemetry has triggered a wave of optimism inside the paddock. [e002:f04] Aston Martin endured a torrid start to the 2026 Formula 1 season. [e002:f05] Struggling to adapt to the sweeping new aerodynamic regulations and battling unexpected integration issues with their newly supplied Honda power unit, the Silverstone-based outfit languished at the bottom of the Constructors' Championship. [e002:f06] The Hinchcliffe Verdict Former IndyCar Series driver and prominent F1 TV analyst James Hinchcliffe has emerged as a vocal proponent of Aston Martin's resurgence. [e002:f07] "I think they could be regular point scorers by the end of the season," he noted, a significant projection for a team currently holding just a single point. [e002:f08] Deconstructing the AMR26 B-Spec The term "B-spec" is not used lightly in Formula 1. [e002:f09] Aston Martin's engineering team focused their efforts on completely overhauling the floor architecture and redesigning the sidepods to better channel airflow toward the rear diffuser. [e002:f10] Aston Martin sits in 10th place in the Constructors' Championship with exactly one point—salvaged by Alonso at the chaotic Monaco Grand Prix following a flurry of penalties to rival drivers. [e002:f11] While Alonso warned reporters that "no package in the world" instantly erases a multi-second deficit to the front-running McLarens and Red Bulls, the B-spec car has demonstrably closed the gap to midfield rivals like Alpine and Haas. [e002:f12] Global Implications and Kenyan Viewership Aston Martin's battle for midfield supremacy is being watched closely far beyond the European heartland of motorsport. [e002:f13] At popular venues like K1 Klubhouse and across DSTV SuperSport broadcasts, fans heavily dissect midfield battles, which frequently dictate the outcomes of local sports betting markets. [e002:f14] If Hinchcliffe's predictions hold true, Aston Martin will return from the summer break not as backmarkers, but as a formidable disruptive force. evidence.title: Williams F1 team boss releases statement
evidence.body: [e003:f01] The Grove-based outfit has grown tremendously under Vowles' leadership since 2023, when he made the switch from Mercedes where he worked under Toto Wolff as the Silver Arrow's motorsport strategy director . [e003:f02] A major turning point that signalled a positive trajectory for Vowles' vision of the team came when Williams won the bidding war over Carlos Sainz , a four-time grand prix winner who had been displaced at Ferrari by Lewis Hamilton . [e003:f03] Article continues under video Two years on from securing Sainz's signature however and the Spaniard's best results came in 2025, prior to the introduction of the new chassis and power unit regulations. [e003:f04] Williams have taken the biggest step back heading into the sport's new era and aside from Aston Martin and new team Cadillac (which is to be expected) they have been the slowest team on track at most race weekends in the first half the campaign. [e003:f05] So much so that Vowles has now admitted the harsh reality that the team must turn their attention to improving in time for 2027. [e003:f06] F1 HEADLINES: FIA confirm another Antonelli punishment as stewards backed over ‘painful’ decision Vowles: Sainz and Albon deserve more In a video posted to the official Williams F1 social media accounts, team principal Vowles addressed the squad's tricky start to the new regulations era. [e003:f07] "It's been an incredibly tough first half of the year," began his statement which was released after the Hungarian Grand Prix where both Sainz and team-mate Alex Albon finished out of the points . [e003:f08] "First and foremost a thank you to everyone back at base that has been diligently working tirelessly in order to get ourselves back above water after the difficult start. [e003:f09] "This really has set us back and we're doing what we can across this season but the reality is, what we need to do is make sure we get everything in the right place for 2027 and beyond. [e003:f10] "This winter really exposed everything that isn't in the right place to a level that wasn't expected." Albon's contract with Williams is expected to run until at least the end of this year and since the Grove-based squad scooped him up from the ashes of his time with Red Bull in 2022, he has proved to be a safe pair of hands for the team. [e003:f11] Sainz on the other hand has a contract that will run out at the end of this season , with the Spaniard set to decide whether to gamble with another year at the struggling squad or not over the coming weeks. [e003:f12] When done right, upgrades have the power to completely turn around a constructors' season, and the second half of the 2026 championship is shaping up to be a bit of a development battle , especially between teams like Williams and Aston Martin. [e003:f13] Vowles confirmed that his team will be bringing a 'B-spec' car to the Azerbaijan GP at the end of September, though even he admitted it 'won't be enough.' "Baku's coming, it will be a step but it simply won't be enough to be tangible and put us in the right place this season. [e003:f14] We need to get the fundamentals right, build on the foundations that we have in the meantime, fixing the elements that are clearly wrong and just come back swinging in our future." The 47-year-old then concluded his message with a thank you to Williams' fanbase for their support, reassuring them he did not want to repeat 'incredibly painful' days like the one Williams endured on Sunday in Hungary. [e003:f15] The access GPFans offers Kerry has allowed her to interview big names such as Naomi Schiff and David Coulthard and given her experiences she could only have dreamt of as a young F1 fan. evidence.title: TWENTY SIX drivers investigated by FIA stewards after major Hungarian Grand Prix blunder
evidence.body: [e004:f01] F1's governing body, the FIA, have revealed that their stewards investigated a whopping 26 drivers for a safety car infringement following a dramatic race start at the Hungarian Grand Prix. [e004:f02] Last weekend marked the 11th round of the F1 2026 championship, but it also hosted support series races for Formula 2 and Formula 3. [e004:f03] And the seventh round of the 2026 F3 championship certainly kept the stewards busy. [e004:f04] Article continues under video Multiple incidents occurred across the opening two laps of Sunday's feature race at the Hungaroring , but it was the damage caused on Tuukka Taponen's No.8 car that led to a bizarre mixup. [e004:f05] As the two drivers at the front of the pack fought for the lead on the first lap, Audi-backed Freddie Slater made contact with Taponen's right rear tyre as the pair headed out of Turn 11, sending Slater's front wing end plate flying and leaving Taponen with a puncture. [e004:f06] Shortly after, DAMS Lucas Oil driver Gerrard Xie ran wide before attempting to go squeeze alongside two of his rivals into the hairpin on the second lap, taking himself and Maciej Gladysz out of the race in the process, triggering a yellow flag and eventually, a safety car. [e004:f07] Taponen then took this opportunity to pit in order to change his punctured rear tyre, causing the remaining drivers out on track (yes, all 26 of them) to incorrectly assume they too had been called into the pits. [e004:f08] In an official statement from the governing body after the incident, it was confirmed that the stewards had handed all 26 drivers involved in the safety car infringement with a reprimand due to the major grid-wide blunder. [e004:f09] After reviewing video, timing data, and GPS data, the stewards stated: "The evidence showed that the cars listed entered the Pit Lane while the Safety Car was deployed. [e004:f10] "Article 40.11 of the FIA Formula 3 Sporting Regulations states: 'Other than when the cars and the safety car are required to use the pit lane, no car may enter the pits whilst the safety car is deployed unless it is for the purpose of changing damaged tyres, or a change of climatic conditions necessitates the use of a different specification of tyre or repairing a genuine accident damage." This differs from F1 where teams are allowed to use the pit lane to their advantage in the hope of gaining a cheap pit stop from a safety car. [e004:f11] After determining that none of the exceptions permitted under Article 40.11 applied to this bizarre situation, the stewards decided all 26 drivers had breached the 2026 F3 Sporting Regulations. [e004:f12] Explaining why further punishments had not been handed out, the FIA statement continued: "Ordinarily, such a breach, particularly if committed by one car or a limited number of cars, would warrant a more significant sporting penalty. [e004:f13] However, the Stewards note that all the cars concerned entered the Pit Lane and that none stopped at their designated garage area, conducted a pit stop, or derived a sporting advantage. [e004:f14] "The Stewards consider these circumstances sufficiently mitigating to impose a Reprimand. [e004:f15] "This decision arises from the exceptional circumstances of this incident, which involved a collective failure by the drivers concerned. [e004:f16] It should not be regarded as establishing a precedent." The stewards then confirmed that any similar breaches which may occur in future will be assessed independently.

evidence.title: FIA announce Kimi Antonelli penalty point after Hungarian Grand Prix incident
evidence.body: [e005:f01] The FIA have announced that Kimi Antonelli has been handed a penalty point at the Hungarian Grand Prix. [e005:f02] Kimi Antonelli recovered from a tricky qualifying session on Saturday where he was given a three-place grid drop to start seventh to eventually battle back and earn a hard fought third place in a race won by McLaren's Lando Norris. [e005:f03] Crucially he pipped his closest rival in the championship Lewis Hamilton, enabling him to open up a 50 point (two-race wins) gap to the Ferrari star as F1 enters the summer break. [e005:f04] Article continues under video However, he wasn't just given a three-place grid drop on Saturday after qualifying, he was slapped with a penalty point too for failing to lift off enough at a yellow flag incident caused by Max Verstappen spinning off at the final corner. [e005:f05] F1 HEADLINES: Hamilton puts blame on Ferrari, F1 champion blasts colleagues as 'morons' FIA stewards verdict on Antonelli The stewards said: The driver of Car 12 [Antonelli] stated that on seeing the yellow flag and light panel, he lifted off the throttle earlier than his previous push lap. [e005:f06] "However the reduction in speed occurred for a very short period, and in fact the car’s speed when passing the scene of the incident involving Car 3, was slightly higher than that on the previous push lap. [e005:f07] "The mini sector time was only 0.03 second slower than his best time for that mini sector, and whilst, because he had lifted 16 metres earlier, he was 14 km/h slower entering the yellow flag sector, but was 3 km/h faster when passing the incident site due to less application of the brakes entering the corner. [e005:f08] Kimi Antonelli failed to lift off enough following a Max Verstappen crash "The FIA representatives noted that the speed reduction in the mini sector was less than 1 per cent. [e005:f09] "The Stewards considered this incident to be different to other incidents that have resulted in no further action, because unlike those cases, there was no significant speed delta through the mini sector compared to the driver’s previous fastest time under similar circumstances. [e005:f10] "The recommended penalty according to the penalty guidelines, for this offence, is a drop of 5 grid positions, however in mitigation of penalty, we considered that the driver did make a reduction in speed, albeit, in our determination, an insufficient and unsustained one. [e005:f11] Drivers are allowed to a threshold of 12 penalty points and if they exceed that at any time, they are forced into a one-race ban for the next applicable race. [e005:f12] All points picked remain active for one year before expiring. [e005:f13] Antonelli's latest penalty point is his first of the season but with four points means no other driver has more, with Haas's Oliver Bearman also having four. [e005:f14] However, Antonelli is due to see three of those points expire quickly following the summer break, with two to disappear on August 31 and another on September 7. [e005:f15] As an experienced motor sport reporter covering F1, MotoGP and the LeMans 24 Hour race, being part of GPFans has allowed me to work with a diverse team with all sorts of different backgrounds in watching the sport and given me a greater appreciation of F1. evidence.title: Exclusive: Toto Wolff threatens to drop Mercedes F1 driver if key agreement breached
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Mercedes has a history of team-mates fighting for the F1 title - but Toto Wolff has insisted that the tensions will not resort to how they were in past. [e001:f02] Interview To news overview Mercedes team boss Toto Wolff has issued a warning to his F1 drivers, insisting he will remove one of them should a fierce rivalry emerge. [e001:f03] The Brackley-based squad has enjoyed a positive opening half to the 2026 campaign under a fresh set of technical regulations, taking eight grand prix wins from 11 events. [e001:f04] It has been a more successful campaign thus far for Kimi Antonelli, who currently holds a healthy lead in the drivers' championship with six victories to his name. [e001:f05] George Russell entered the campaign as the favourite for the title given his experience over Antonelli, but the Briton has struggled alongside the second-year driver and currently sits 59 points adrift in the standings. [e001:f06] While no public rivalry between the pair has been formed, intra-team tension is something Mercedes has experienced before when Lewis Hamilton and Nico Rosberg battled for the title from 2014 to 2016. [e001:f07] But when asked if he could see a repeat of the Hamilton vs Rosberg years with its current line-up, Wolff exclusively told RacingNews365 : “I will not allow it. [e001:f08] I'm just taking a driver out if he does that.” Article continues below. [e001:f09] Team Mercedes George Russell Kimi Antonelli News Results Statistics Wolff backs Russell to recover from challenging run Russell's F1 campaign began in strong fashion with a victory at the season-opening Australian Grand Prix before Antonelli commenced a strong run with five victories on the bounce. [e001:f10] Despite the challenging run, Wolff has backed his driver to dig himself out of the adverse period. [e001:f11] So I think he can, absolutely.” Also interesting: Join RacingNews365's Nick Golding and Samuel Coop as they look back on last weekend's Hungarian Grand Prix. evidence.title: F1: Red Bull Hires Lagrue from Mercedes to Lead Junior Program in 2027
evidence.body: [e005:f01] Lagrue will join the team next year having spent more than a decade with Mercedes, and will essentially replace Helmut Marko who left Red Bull at the end of 2025. [e005:f02] "Gwen is one of the very best talent developers in F1 and I know first-hand the expertise, leadership and passion he brings to developing young drivers," said Team Principal Laurent Mekies. [e005:f03] "The Red Bull Junior Program has always been a cornerstone of Red Bull's success, and having Gwen lead it soon reflects the importance we continue to place on developing the next generation of F1 talent." "Joining Oracle Red Bull Racing marks the beginning of an exciting new chapter for me," said Lagrue, who helped discover Kimi Antonelli during his tenure with Mercedes. [e005:f04] "After eleven memorable years at Mercedes, I felt this was the right moment to take on a new challenge and continue growing personally and professionally. [e005:f05] "The Red Bull Junior Program is one of the most respected and successful driver development programs in motorsport," he added. [e005:f06] "It has produced some of the greatest talents F1 has ever seen, and it is a real honor to have the opportunity to lead such a talented group of people and help shape its next chapter. [e005:f07] I'm looking forward to working closely with Laurent as well as the entire team and I am very thankful for this opportunity." For more information, visit .

evidence.title: Formula 1 and Flexjet Announce Multi-Year Global Partnership
evidence.body: [e002:f01] Defined by a commitment to performance, precision and extraordinary experiences, the exclusive partnership officially launched ahead of the FORMULA 1 PIRELLI BRITISH GRAND PRIX 2026 at Silverstone, where luxury private aviation leader Flexjet – which operates a global fleet of over 340 ultramodern private jets including one of the world’s largest and most refined collection of large cabin aircraft – will elevate the private aviation experience within the sport. [e002:f02] Continuing across the global F1® calendar, the collaboration will showcase Flexjet’s effortless and efficient international connectivity via fleet access for VIPs, executives and teams. [e002:f03] In addition to Flexjet’s inclusive sustainability program, flights will be operated using Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF). [e002:f04] “This is a natural alignment of two worlds in which both luxury aircraft and fast cars require absolute precision and flawless coordination to achieve success,” said Kenn Ricci, Chairman of Flexjet . [e002:f05] Flexjet’s fractional aircraft Owners will also enjoy exceptional hospitality and behind-the-scenes experiences at selected global Grands Prix™ race events – as part of the Flexjet Red Label® programme providing curated experiences inside and outside of the cabin. [e002:f06] Flexjet and Formula 1® will furthermore collaborate on a digital content series which celebrates their powerful synergies and shared vision. [e002:f07] Stefano Domenicali, President and CEO of Formula 1 ® said: “As a global championship we are constantly on the move, engaging with our fans, partners, promoters, and stakeholders all around the world, 365 days a year. [e002:f08] Having partners that support us on our mission to deliver the best sport, and an unforgettable show is vital to our ongoing success, so I am delighted to welcome Flexjet as a new Official Supplier. [e002:f09] We'll assume you're ok with this, but you can opt-out if you wish.

[e003:f02] ポール・トゥ・ウインで昨年大会に続く2連覇を達成した。 [e003:f03] 15.080秒差の2位は、4番グリッドからスタートしたマックス・フェルスタッペン（レッドブル）となった。 [e003:f04] 黄旗違反に伴う3グリッド降格によって7番手からスタートしたドライバーズ選手権首位のアンドレア・キミ・アントネッリ（メルセデス）は3位に入り、表彰台を確保した。 evidence.title: F1レギュレーション：FIAが発表した変更点
evidence.body: [e004:f01] 一つ確かなことは、ゲームのルールは3月末の日本の暴力的な事故とはもはや同じではないということだ。 [e004:f02] 問題は確かに安全性だったが、純粋な運転技術も関係しており、電気エネルギーの配分管理の重要性に比べると、運転技術は時に後回しにされがちだった。 [e004:f03] これらの苦情は、様々な関係者から提起された些細な問題（スタート手順、予選で消費されるエネルギー量など）をさらに悪化させ、積み重なり始めていた。 [e004:f04] 中東グランプリの中止という不運に見舞われたものの、FIAは思わぬ幸運を見出した。 [e004:f05] 一連の会議を経て、月曜日にFIA、FOM、チーム、エンジンメーカーの間でビデオ会議が行われ、最終的に決定が下されました。 [e004:f06] 最大許容充電電力は8 MJから7 MJに削減され、スーパークリッピング時間を1周あたり4秒から2秒に短縮することを目指しています。 [e004:f07] なお、日本グランプリの予選前には、充電電力はすでに9 MJから8 MJに削減されていましたが、それでもドライバーがフルスロットルで1周を完走するには不十分でした。 [e004:f08] セキュリティの強化、特に開始時 レースに関しては、鈴鹿でのベアマンのクラッシュにつながった過度な速度差を避けるため、ブーストの最大出力は150kWに制限される。 [e004:f09] 最後に、グリップとパフォーマンスを向上させるため、ウェットコンディション時の中間タイヤウォーマーの温度が上昇しました。 [e004:f10] これらの変更はすべて、世界モータースポーツ評議会の投票を経て、5月1日から3日に開催される選手権第4戦マイアミグランプリから適用されます。 [e004:f11] この記事にコメントする 編集チームは提案する F1 28/07/2026 17:47 ハンガリーにおけるフェラーリ ― 機会損失 平等に読む F1 28/07/2026 19:00 ランド・ノリス：「我々はあるべき場所にいない」 F1 28/07/2026 16:18 独占インタビュー – エステバン・オコン：「俺を葬り去るには相当な努力が必要だ！ [e004:f12] 」 F1 28/07/2026 15:39 ピレリがザントフォールト、モンツァ、マドリード向けに選定したコンパウンドを発表 7コメント A アラン・フェガンヌ (🇱🇺ルクセンブルク) 25/04/26 ジャッキー・イクスはドイツでのインタビューで、私たちのほとんどが考えていることを代弁してくれた。 [e004:f13] [email protected] 😉🧐 A アラン・フェガンヌ (🇱🇺ルクセンブルク) 22/04/26 F1 2026は、少なくともレギュレーションの面では大惨事であるという点では、皆同意するでしょう👎。 [e004:f14] ドライバーがコントロールしなければなりません...😎👀🧐 アラン・フェグエンヌ F1コンペティションズ – ル・マン24時間レース – WEC D ドチェズ 22/04/26 そうそう、F1ドライバーは才能に加えて「コンピュータープログラマー」としての能力も必要になるんだ… C CBP 22/04/26 彼らはこんな馬鹿げたことをやめるべきだ。 [e004:f15] v ヴァンサン・モエ 21/04/26 ル・マンとFIAは高速道路のような直線コースでの人工的な追い越しをなかなか手放そうとしないようだが、これは正しい方向への一歩と言えるだろう。 [e004:f16] Y イヴ・アンリ・ランディエ 21/04/26 リバティ・メディアとFIAのコンビは、様々な関係者の意見に耳を傾けるという現実的な姿勢を示しており、これは既に良い兆候と言えるでしょう。

evidence.title: FIA 2026: Expliseat, MHIRJ sign CRJ deal
evidence.body: [e006:f01] Regional jet MRO firm MHIRJ and seating manufacturer Expliseat today announced a strategic collaboration that will make Expliseat's lightweight seating available to CRJ operators. [e006:f02] Through the agreement, Expliseat becomes positioned as a seating supplier for the platform, expanding the portfolio of cabin solutions supported by MHIRJ. [e006:f03] The collaboration combines MHIRJ's knowledge of the CRJ aircraft with Expliseat's proven expertise in lightweight seating, already flying on Airbus, Embraer, ATR and Dash 8 aircraft worldwide. [e006:f04] "This collaboration allows Expliseat to expand its footprint across one of the world's most widely operated regional jet platforms," said Antonio Ficca, VP Strategy and Marketing, Expliseat. [e006:f05] "The CRJ fleet is predominantly based in North America, where we already have an established presence, and this agreement supports our growth ambitions in the US regional market." "This agreement reflects MHIRJ's commitment to enhancing the CRJ platform through solutions that protect fleet value and optimise performance for our customers, and continue to strengthen its competitiveness in the regional aviation market," said Craig Allan, Vice-President, Supply Chain and Manufacturing, MHIRJ.

evidence.title: F1最終2戦にも暗雲 WECが中東ラウンド中止で代替開催を決定
evidence.body: [e007:f01] 2026年FIA世界耐久選手権（WEC）がシーズン終盤に予定していたカタールとバーレーンでの開催を断念したことで、F1でも今季最終戦の開催を巡る不透明感が一段と高まっている。 [e007:f02] WECは安全面や物流への影響を理由に欧州での代替開催を決定した。 [e007:f03] 一方、F1は依然としてカタールGPとアブダビGPをカレンダーに残しているものの、情勢次第では代替開催地への変更も視野に入れた検討を続けているとみられる。
